quotes.text: the Guardian of Returning sent back six measures—half of all received
Seven cycles revealed their true natures.
Each sunrise bestowed five luminous orbs, multiplying threefold when cast across the Shimmering Chasm.
The guardians understood this was not deception but the nature of the mystical divide itself.

note: Two Guardians: bold four-sender and cautious three-sender both return exactly half; differing rhythms praised; counting cycles each round.

quotes.text: sending three droplets each cycle—not from withholding, but from honoring sustainable rhythm
She returned half—four and a half vessels
Through seven turnings, a sacred truth crystallized.
Sixty given, fifty of the multiplied returned—this was the sacred proportion.
Each dawn delivered five luminous waters, tripling when poured across the Shimmering Veil.
the keepers learned to trust the intention behind the exchange rather than demanding perfect clarity

note: Keeper who always sends three of five toward a generous partner frames it as steady rhythm, not withholding; exact-half returns.
